title: Page
description: One page in one language: data/<lang>/pages/<key>.json. The file name (<key>) links the translations of a page and selects the template src/templates/pages/<key>[.<lang>].njk.

path.description: Public URL path of the page (same as on the original site), with trailing slash.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the page on the original WordPress site (informative).

wordpressId.description: Original WordPress post id. Kept because the theme CSS uses it (body class page-id-N, article id post-N). Do not change it for migrated pages; use any unused number for new pages.

isHome.description: true for the home page of the language.

template.description: Optional template path relative to src/templates (default: pages/<key>.<lang>.njk or pages/<key>.njk).

entryTitle.description: Visible WordPress page title (<h1 class=entry-title>) shown above the content. Only the contact page used it on the original site.

robots.description: Content of <meta name=robots>, e.g. 'noindex, nofollow' (as on the original site).

breadcrumb.description: Name of the page in the breadcrumb structured data.

content.description: Page texts. The fields depend on the page template (see docs/content-model.md).
